description: Bethel Hub Center is a well-established neighborhood shopping destination strategically located at the intersection of Greenwood Avenue and Grassy Plains Road in Bethel, Connecticut. This 30,986 square foot community-oriented center serves the affluent residential areas of Bethel and surrounding towns, offering convenient access to essential retail and services. Managed by Regency Centers, a nationally recognized shopping center developer and operator, the property benefits from professional management and a commitment to creating thriving neighborhood centers. The center features key retailers including LA PLACITA BETHEL MARKET and maintains strong community connections with over 313,000 annual visits. With 4 available spaces and opportunities for new tenants, Bethel Hub Center continues to evolve as a vital part of the local retail landscape, serving a prosperous trade area with household incomes exceeding $112,000 and home values averaging nearly $470,000.
